test_get_available_skills: test the hermes_cli.banner.get_available_skills function delegates to _find_all_skills and groups skills by category
test_get_available_skills_excludes_disab: test get_available_skills excludes disabled skills from the returned category map
test_get_available_skills_empty_when_no_: test get_available_skills returns an empty dict when no skills are installed
test_get_available_skills_handles_import: test get_available_skills returns an empty dict gracefully when _find_all_skills raises ImportError
test_get_available_skills_null_category_: test get_available_skills maps skills with None category to the 'general' key
